assets.standard_ref: 3GPP TS 33.501 Annex C Profile A (Vulnerable to Quantum Decryption)

findings.title: Vulnerable Classical SUCI Concealment (Profile A Curve25519)
findings.description: Shor's algorithm breaks discrete logarithm on Curve25519. Eavesdropped SUCI ciphertexts can be stored and decrypted post-quantum to reveal permanent subscriber IMSI (HNDL).
findings.remediation: Upgrade UDM/SIDF and USIM profiles to Profile D (Hybrid ML-KEM-768 + X25519).

findings.title: Quantum-Vulnerable SBA Token Signing (RSA-2048)
findings.description: Quantum computers running Shor's algorithm can factor 2048-bit RSA keys, allowing attackers to forge NRF access tokens and hijack core NFs.
findings.remediation: Deploy QuantaCipher SBA Token Gateway with ML-DSA-65 or Hybrid signing.

findings.title: Vulnerable Classical Roaming Interconnect (ECDH JWE)
findings.description: Inter-carrier roaming traffic traversing IPX providers can be recorded by adversaries and decrypted retroactively using quantum computers.
findings.remediation: Deploy QuantaCipher SEPP PRINS Engine with Hybrid X-Wing KEM bilaterally.

findings.title: Null Ciphering Enabled (NEA0 / EEA0)
findings.description: Null encryption transmits user plane and/or NAS control signaling completely unencrypted over the air.
findings.remediation: Enforce NEA2 (AES-128) minimum, preferably NEA4 (AES-256) for quantum resilience.
